MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The assorted heat shrink kit fits my small electronics work because its range of sizes would help insulate connections made with my wires, PCB boards, and connectors.",
    "The multimeter feels useful for checking voltage and continuity when troubleshooting breadboard and relay circuits; it supports the projects suggested by my past purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another caster set repeats a purchase without a clear new need, while waterproof putty and cutting wheels require repair or cutting projects I have not indicated.",
    "The heavy battery lugs are too large for my small circuit wiring, eighteen rolls of tape exceed my occasional needs, and examination gloves do not serve an evident task.",
    "The single-size heat shrink tubing is relevant, but I would choose the assorted kit this time because it gives me more flexibility across small connections."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hardware purchases seem to have been taken as interest in general repair supplies, even though I choose supplies for specific jobs.",
    "Electrical wiring seems to have been treated as one broad need, overlooking the difference between small circuit connections and heavy battery cables."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, relay module, PCB supplies, and battery holder together suggest small electronics assembly and troubleshooting, where compatible sizes and practical supporting tools matter.",
    "A recent durable purchase can mean that need is already covered; buying casters does not mean I currently want another set.",
    "Quantity and flexibility affect my choices: an assortment of useful tubing sizes suits me better than a large stock of tape or a single tubing size."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly understood my small electronics projects but stretched that interest into general repair work and repeat purchases without a clear current need."
}
